findings.comment: Demolition plan sequence notes (Sheet 8, Block 9) do not address required safety clearances from transmission lines. Missing: (1) pre-construction safety meeting requirement ≥48 hours before commencement with Austin Energy; (2) barricade requirement 10 feet from all transmission structures, including guys and anchors; (3) warning signs under overhead transmission facilities; (4) prohibition on materials and spoils storage within the transmission easement. Current notes only reference Environmental Inspector meeting and utility abandonment.

applicableAreas: construction area adjacent to transmission easement
findings.comment: Construction and staging plans do not demonstrate maintenance of a 25-foot-wide access corridor with minimum 16-foot vertical clearance along the full transmission ROW length. The transmission easement location is not clearly delineated on the Erosion and Sedimentation Control Plan (Sheet 5), and no construction plan explicitly shows the transmission access corridor dimensions required by UCM 1.14.4.

Demolition plan general notes do not include a requirement for contractor to use extreme caution when working near at-grade utility appurtenances. While the demolition notes address tree protection, utility abandonment, and safety meetings, there is no specific caution language warning the contractor about the electrical utility infrastructure present on the site.

Cannot verify that staging and temporary spoils areas are not overlapping with transmission easement because the transmission easement boundary is not clearly delineated on the Erosion and Sedimentation Control Plan. While Sheet 5 identifies a 'Staging and Storage Area' and 'Concrete Truck Cleanout' on the western side of the site, and Sheet 3 notes explicitly prohibit materials storage within the transmission easement, the transmission easement location is not graphically shown to verify compliance with the separation requirement.
